title: Improving students’ reading, comprehension, and reading motivation through texts generated from their prompts using ChatGPT-4: a mixed-method study
core_idea: Use ChatGPT-4 to generate texts from 4th-grade students' own prompts as an intervention to support reading skills, reading comprehension, and reading motivation; evaluated via a sequential explanatory mixed-methods study (Solomon four-group experimental design for quantitative and a case study for qualitative) with 106 students in two public primary schools.
tldr: This study investigates whether texts generated by ChatGPT-4 from students' prompts can be used to support reading, comprehension, and motivation among 4th graders, using a sequential explanatory mixed-methods design (Solomon four-group experiment plus case study) with 106 students in two public primary schools.
